scope: Bounded public source availability audit of real repository version screenshot pairs; no model evaluation or synthetic CSS changes.
word_policy: FROZEN. No editing, overwriting, copying as a new version, or invoking taskbook writers without explicit user request.

word_reference.archive_path: protocol/网页截图的细微变更分类｜实验任务书_v1.1.docx

sample: 6 candidate modified screenshot paths and2 unchanged controls from2 projects; exploratory source verification, not representative benchmark
pairing_rule: Exact same repository path at a selected commit and its first parent; both Git blob hashes verified; unchanged controls child tree checked
pixel_rule: Compare decoded RGB at original geometry; different dimensions flagged without resizing; report overlap difference separately
grouping_rule: All commits, components, browsers and viewports within a repository are one project group; not independent websites
label_policy: No automatic13-class labels from commit title. Review source changes and pixels; mixed or ambiguous change stays unlabelled. justify and position coverage only reported where supported.
excluded: Old419,355,155 and72 confirmation examples; all prior methods/results unchanged
export_policy: Only code, configuration, hashes, source URLs and filtered audit metadata; no raw images, upstream source documents, full logs, weights or credentials
